Uttar Pradesh sees train disruptions and electricity bill changes in July

In Uttar Pradesh, 14 trains have been cancelled and 30 rerouted, impacting travel plans for July. Separately, electricity consumers in the state are set to receive reduced bills for July, with one report stating a decrease of 4.43 percent, attributed to a relief measure.
